tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250dpal bde mchog 'khor lo'i gsol 'debs bzhugs so// 1$0000300

chos rgyal thugs dam/ he ru ka dpal rdo rje phag mo dang*// su kha siddhi rig 'dzin thod phreng rtsal// mnga' bdag yab sras ma gcig mtsho rgyal ma// gar gyi dbang phyug rtsal la gsol ba 'debs// kun tu bzang po rigs lnga sems dpa'i tshogs// dga' rab shrī siṃ rig 'dzin padma 'byung*// mnga' bdag yab sras ma gcig mtsho rgyal ma// gar gyi dbang phyug zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// byin rlabs kun 'byung rtsa brgyud bla ma dang*// dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol ba'i yi dam lha// bar chad sel ba'i mkha' 'gro bka' srung dang*// gter srung dam can rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bdag gis khyed la gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// snang srid dbang sdud srid gsum zil gyis mnan// bskyed rim gding thob bzlas brjod sngags 'grub ste// thugs mchog rig pa'i ye shes mngon gyur shog /nyin mtshan mtha' bral gdod ma'i mgon po mchog /lus gnad rlung gnad gnad du mthun pa dang*// ldem dang dwangs ldem ar la gtad pa yis// rtags bcu rdzogs nas snang bzhi mthar phyin shog /de yang chos sku ka dag bde ba che// longs sku lug rgyud rang rtsal ma nges pa// sprul sku zer bzhin 'gro don dpag med kyis// 'gro kun tshe gcig 'od lus 'grub par shog / ces pa bde mchog 'khor lo'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs shig dgos zhes/ nyang stod tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyis bskul ba la rdzogs chen pa gar gyi dbang phyug rtsal gyis bkod pa'o// dge'o/// /
